notes:
{小銭|こぜに} refers to coins or small change.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {小銭|こぜに}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧/⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ (to have/not have change)
- {小銭|こぜに}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧ (to carry change)
- {小銭|こぜに}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧ (to take out coins)
- {小銭|こぜに}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦たまる→溜まる：02067_tamaru⟧ (coins accumulate)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {小銭|こぜに}: coins, small change (casual)
- ⟦{硬貨|こうか}→硬貨：02745_kouka⟧: coins (formal/technical)
- ⟦おつり→お釣り：00878_otsuri⟧: change (what you receive back)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{小銭|こぜに}{入|い}れ→小銭入れ：20896_kozeniire⟧ (coin purse)
- {小銭|こぜに}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{崩|くず}す→崩す：03919_kuzusu⟧ (to break a bill into coins)
